title: fulgur allows Unbounded string-set value accumulation causes memory/CPU exhaustion (denial of service) (CVE-2026-68539)
description: A vulnerability in fulgur versions from 0.4.4 up to but not including 0.28.0 allows unbounded accumulation of CSS string-set values during HTML/CSS to PDF conversion. This causes excessive memory and CPU usage, resulting in denial of service. The flaw arises because attacker-controlled string-set values are copied and stored without limits, amplifying memory consumption especially when repeated across many elements. The issue is fixed in version 0.28.0 by bounding memory usage for string-set storage and snapshots.
